project.$comment: One lane at the repository root: every verb runs the root npm script that CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs, so nen shu and CI cannot disagree. npm only.

lint.why: ESLint (one root flat config) over every workspace, then a Prettier check.

typecheck.why: tsc --noEmit in every workspace; apps/web generates its Next route types first.

test.why: Vitest across packages/* from the root config; writes JUnit results and an lcov coverage report (both git-ignored).

build.why: Production build of every workspace that has one (today apps/web: next build).

dev.why: The apps/web Next.js dev server on localhost.

run.why: The apps/web production server; requires a prior build.

coverage.why: The same root Vitest run, which always captures v8 coverage of packages/*/src into coverage/lcov.info. Prefer nen shu coverage --from-capture after a test run.

archive.unsupported: Nothing is packaged: the web app is deployed from source and the Expo app is a scaffold with no build profile.

release.unsupported: No release or store pipeline: a private, single-user dashboard with no published package.

deploy.unsupported: No deploy target is wired; any deployment must sit behind access protection and is the owner's call.

node.why: Node 24 is the declared runtime (.nvmrc, package.json engines) and what CI runs.

npm.why: npm is the only package manager; workspaces and the single root package-lock.json need npm 11.
